wavify.midnightconfig.title: Wavify Config
wavify.midnightconfig.reloadReminder: You may need to reload your chunks for changes to take affect!
wavify.midnightconfig.chunkRadius.toolti: The chunk radius of chunks that should spawn waves. Reduce this number if your struggling for performance!
wavify.midnightconfig.chunkUpdatesRescan: The amount of block updates that should happen in a chunk before it is rescanned for wave spawning.
wavify.midnightconfig.debug.tooltip: Helpful for figuring out where waves are spawning, and how.
wavify.midnightconfig.debugDocsSite: - Green particles are SitePos', they should only spawn along shore
wavify.midnightconfig.debugDocsSpyglassH: - Spyglass in hotbar to see all scanned water blocks, color coded per closest SitePos
wavify.midnightconfig.debugDocsSpyglass: - Hold spyglass to see debug waves on wave spawn
wavify.midnightconfig.debugDocsClock: - Hold compass to see wave directions for current chunk, offhand to for all nearby chunks
wavify.midnightconfig.debugDocsCompass: - Offhand clock to see spawning positions of waves
wavify.midnightconfig.enableRiverWaves.t: Master toggle for all river-related waves (moving and standing). Turn off if you don't want waves on rivers.
wavify.midnightconfig.waveYOffset.toolti: Shifts the whole wave (body and foam) up or down. Applied in both vanilla and shader modes. Negative = lower.
wavify.midnightconfig.shaderWaveYSink.to: Only applied when an Iris/Oculus shaderpack is active. Sinks the wave body below water so the shaderpack's water reflections render on top. More negative = waves sit deeper. 0 disables shader compensation.
wavify.midnightconfig.enableWaveSounds.t: Plays a looping ambient ocean sound when ocean waves are nearby, and a river sound when river waves are nearby. Sounds fade in/out smoothly.
wavify.midnightconfig.waveSoundVolume.to: Master volume multiplier for the ocean and river ambient loops.
Master toggle for ocean and beach (shoreline) waves. Turn off if you only want river waves, or no waves at all.
Darkens the ground where a wave washes up, as if the sand got wet. Turn off to disable the effect entirely.
Master toggle for river waves. Turn off if you don't want waves on rivers.
wavify.configuration.river_wave_spawn_ra: Radius (in blocks) around you within which river waves spawn. Larger = waves appear further away; smaller = only close by.
